from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u020/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nr, nc = rr+dr, cc+dc
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] != 0 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            components.append(cells)
    for cells in components:
        colors = {grid[r][c] for r,c in cells}
        if len(colors) == 3:
            r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
            return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    raise ValueError("No three-color object found")
'''
p=program_dir/'task-c2d00d70.py'
p.write_text(code)

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_c2d00d70',p)
